miht.title: Do You Feel Safe? A Mother Tells Her Counselor the Truth | Mommy Is Human Too
miht.desc:
Mommy goes to a counselor, and when she's asked "Do you feel safe in your community?" she tells the truth: no. A police stop on her son's Sunday walk. A cruel name on her daughter's bus ride. A school that called the police on her. Family who love her saying she takes it too far. And the fear that telling will only make it worse.

This is a story about racism, fear, and the courage to speak up, told from a mother's side, and about what she teaches her children at the kitchen table: who they are, what to do if police stop them, what to do when someone calls them a name, and how to set heavy thoughts down sooner.

Mommy is human. And so are you.
